insight: Specialist-pause recurred 2026-06-10 during R-B: 3/5 crew dispatches (builder, reviewer, validator) returned narration without artifact/verdict. SOP applied (fixup re-dispatch, reviewer retry with hard output-contract worked, lead-run validation scenarios). Pattern persists past SOP's 5-slice threshold — file upstream-request FEAT against hero-crew for prompt-level 'last tool call MUST be write-*' enforcement.

Granting a deferred tool in agent frontmatter (e.g. tools: [Agent]) is necessary but not sufficient. Subagent must call ToolSearch(query: 'select:<ToolName>') to load the tool's schema before invocation. Without ToolSearch, the tool appears absent from active surface. Validated 2026-06-12 via PM dispatch on FEAT-085 retriage — PM saw [Read,Grep,Glob,Bash] only, dispatch failed silently. Likely retroactive cause for N% of crew:lead specialist-pause cases (FEAT-191). Rule: whenever granting a deferred tool, add ToolSearch instruction to the agent prompt in the SAME slice.
